Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.Board
public class Board extends Object
Ground truth of the current game state.

Holds the observable state of the table: the tribe deck, visible card rows, per-era building decks, Offer Track, Turn Order Tile, and current era.

Board exposes methods to modify and query state. Event order and era transitions are coordinated by Game.

  • Method Details

    • setupBottomRow

      public void setupBottomRow(int numPlayers)
      Draws cards from the tribe deck to form the initial bottom row (players + 1 cards, rulebook p.2 point 4). Event cards drawn here go to the top row instead; drawing continues until enough non-event cards are in the bottom row.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players

    • setupTopRow

      public void setupTopRow(int numPlayers)
      Draws cards from the tribe deck to form the initial top row (players + 4 cards) Accounts for event cards already in the top row from setupBottomRow.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players

    • moveTopToBottom

      public void moveTopToBottom()

    • refillTopRow

      public boolean refillTopRow(int numPlayers)
      Refills the top row by drawing new cards from the tribe deck (players + 4, rulebook p.6 point 4). Also detects whether a new era has begun. Note: currentEra is updated by advanceEra(), called by Game when this returns true.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players
      Returns:
      true if a card from a new era was revealed during the refill

    • advanceEra

      public void advanceEra(Era newEra)
      Advances to the next era, applying the transition rules (rulebook p.7): 1. When advancing to Era III: discard buildings from the bottom row 2. Move buildings from the top row to the bottom row 3. Place the new era's buildings in the top row
      Parameters:
      newEra - the era that has just begun

    • resolveBottomRowEvents

      public List<Board.ResolvedEvent> resolveBottomRowEvents(List<Player> players)
      Collects and resolves events in the bottom row. Sustenance is always resolved last (rulebook p.5). When two events of the same type appear in the same round, the lower-era one is resolved first (rulebook p.5). Returns the list of resolved events so Game can publish EventResolved for each.
      Parameters:
      players - list of all players
      Returns:
      list of resolved events

    • resolveAllVisibleEvents

      public List<Board.ResolvedEvent> resolveAllVisibleEvents(List<Player> players)
      Collects and resolves all visible events (top and bottom row). Returns the list of resolved events so Game can publish EventResolved for each. Used during the final round (rulebook p.7).
      Parameters:
      players - list of all players
      Returns:
      list of resolved events
